# Ranos Homes

## About
Ranos Homes is a Nigerian furniture maker and interior design studio focused on premium furniture, custom pieces, and residential and commercial interior projects.

## What We Do
- Custom and ready-made furniture for living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and offices
- Interior design services for homes and commercial spaces
- Furniture discovery and enquiries through WhatsApp-first lead capture

## Content Priorities
- Furniture store in Lagos
- Luxury furniture Nigeria
- Buy sofa Lagos
- Interior designer Lagos
- Nigerian home decor and furniture buying guides

## Website Notes
- The site is built with Next.js
- Product and content management is planned for Sanity CMS
- Product imagery should be optimised with Cloudinary
- Payments are not implemented; all high-intent enquiries go to WhatsApp
